observations.content: Tool smoke-test Batch 1 PASS for all 8/8 tools: write, read, edit, find, grep, ls, bash, safe_bash.

render_mermaid and render_svg both published to viz/ with save_as: viz-tool-test-flow-1788085300466.png and viz-tool-test-label-1788085299444.png under /home/coder/workspaces/learn/viz/.

MCP paseo read-only calls working: paseo_list_providers returned 8 providers (claude, codex, copilot, opencode, pi, omp, factory-droid, gemini); only pi and omp enabled/available.
omp provider has 3 approval modes: full (yolo, unattended), write (writes require approval), ask (always ask); pi provider has no modes.

Agent list included prior scout subagents 'Vision check diagram' (a198865d), 'Vision check SVG' (5716b7fc), 'Vision check edit_svg' (4a55264b) all glm-5.3-flash medium thinking under parent c627c4af, plus omp agents for reading HANDOFF-observational-memory.md and github.com/amosblomqvist.

Batch 4: spawned scout subagent 'Tool-test vision check' (id be46a8af-a28e-4bb5-9df1-6d0923b7b15b, status running) to vision-verify both published PNGs; poll via paseo_get_agent_activity when notified.

analyze-sessions skill inspected: description says analyze Paseo agent sessions across providers (omp, pi, claude, codex, copilot, opencode, factory-droid) using stdlib Py3 scripts reading ~/.paseo/agents/ plus provider-native transcripts.

analyze-sessions paseo_cost.py supports breakdowns by total/day/workspace/provider/model/kind/agent with --since and --limit; cost split into input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite/total on assistant messages.

Four session kinds on machine per analyze-sessions: main (human-created), subagent (spawn_subagent with subagent.role label), om-observer/om-consolidator (observational-memory worker pi sessions under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/<ws>-.memory-<id>--/).
